beats.vo: Ninety-two students started in one atrium.
The top five scores all came through one door, fifty-three steps away.
It opened only when three students stood on three red pads, and pushed together.
In nineteen hours, it opened four times.
The room outside is where players spent the most time.
And the chat there says: we need one more person.
Ten got through, and every one of them scored twenty-four or more.
To reach the top, you needed two other people, at the same time.
